title: Fit G and 2D Raman peaks and save results
query: Using the supplied Raman Setup output file for a graphene sample, fit the G and 2D peaks of the spectrum and determine each peak's x0, gamma, amplitude, and offset, then write the results to /app/results.json in the specified JSON format with "G" and "2D" objects.
review_flags: The input Raman spectrum output file path/name is not specified in the task.
